visualCharacteristics: Promo card grid inside a grey section, three cards per row on desktop (two on tablet, one on mobile). Each card has a 16:9 image on top and a text body below with a bold title, optional eyebrow/date, a short description, and a CTA link.
contentPattern: Two columns per row: cell 1 is the card image, cell 2 is the card body (title + optional date/eyebrow + description + CTA link). One row per card.
usage: Use for a grid of promotional event cards with image, title, date, description and a call to action.
